title: Normalized coefficient comparison with adjunct compatibility
statement: Fix the comparison data $m$ of [def-weil-pbc-flat-ringed-diagram-comparisons] for the module diagram functors of [def-weil-pbc-flat-ringed-diagram-input], with localization $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Given inverse-image factor isomorphisms $q_{LB}:L_BQ\simeq QL_B^0$, define inverse normalization by the equality, for every complex $P$ of $S_V$-module diagrams, $\bar r_U(q_{LS,P});q_{U,L_S^0P};Q(b^0_P)=b_{QP};L_R(q_{V,P});q_{LR,r_VP}$. Given direct-image units $\eta_B:QF_B^0\to F_BQ$, define direct normalization by the equality, for every complex $I$ of $S_U$-module diagrams, $\bar r_V(\eta_{S,I});d_{QI};F_R(q_{U,I})=q_{V,F_S^0I};Q(d^0_I);\eta_{R,r_UI}$. Given derived adjunctions $a_B:L_B\dashv F_B$, adjunct compatibility means that for every $M\in D(\mathcal A_{V,S})$, $N\in D(\mathcal A_{U,S})$ and $t:L_SM\to N$, one has $a_R(b_M^{-1};\bar r_U(t))=\bar r_V(a_S(t));d_N$. Here $a_B$ denotes its Hom bijection, semicolon is left-to-right composition, and the superscript $0$ denotes ordinary termwise image functors before localization, extended degreewise on complexes. A full derived restriction comparison consists of $m$, its ordinary underlying-identity normalization [def-weil-pbc-flat-ringed-diagram-input], the inverse and direct normalization equations, and adjunct compatibility.
